gita.text: You have a right to perform your prescribed duties, but you are not entitled to the fruits of your actions. Never consider yourself to be the cause of the results of your activities, nor be attached to inaction.
gita.situation: worrying about future results or career stress

gita.text: The soul is neither born, nor does it ever die; nor having once existed, does it ever cease to be. The soul is without birth, eternal, immortal, and ageless. It is not destroyed when the body is destroyed.
gita.situation: loss of a loved one or grief

gita.text: For the mind is restless, turbulent, obstinate and very strong, O Krishna. To subdue it, it seems to me, is more difficult than controlling the wind. But it can be controlled through constant practice and detachment.
He who sees Me everywhere and sees everything in Me, is never lost to Me, nor am I ever lost to him. Established in unity, he worships Me dwelling in all beings.
A person is said to have achieved yoga when they have surrendered all material desires, and carry no attachment to the objects of the senses or to actions.

Delusion arises from anger, and mind-bewilderment from delusion. When the mind is bewildered, reasoning is destroyed, and when reasoning is destroyed, a person is ruined. Therefore, control the senses first.

bible.text: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.

Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God. And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds.
Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
Be angry and do not sin; do not let the sun go down on your anger, and give no opportunity to the devil. Let all bitterness and wrath be put away.

quran.text: So truly where there is hardship, there is also ease; indeed, with hardship comes ease. Therefore, when you are free, toil on, and turn all your attention to your Lord.
quran.situation: going through a tough phase, feeling overwhelmed

quran.text: Those who believe and whose hearts find rest in the remembrance of God - indeed, in the remembrance of God do hearts find rest.
And He is with you wherever you are. And God sees all that you do.
Do not lose heart nor fall into despair, for you will be superior if you are true believers. God does not burden a soul beyond that which it can bear.
Who repress anger, and who pardon men; verily, God loves the doers of good. When they are angered, they forgive.

buddhism.text: Let us live happily then, free from hatred among those who hate. Among men who hate, let us dwell free from hatred. Let us live happily, free from anxiety among the anxious.
buddhism.situation: dealing with toxic people or conflict

buddhism.text: Your own mind, and not your enemy, is what lures you into evil ways. A disciplined mind brings happiness. There is no fire like passion; there is no losing throw like anger.
Just as a solid rock is not shaken by the wind, even so, the wise are not moved by praise or blame. They remain in calm stillness.
He who has surrendered all attachments, who has overcome sorrow, dwells in perfect peace. The quiet mind is the source of greatest joy.

stoicism.text: You have power over your mind - not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength. The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
stoicism.situation: overthinking things out of your control

stoicism.text: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality. A man is as wretched as he has convinced himself he is. Limit yourself to the present moment.
stoicism.situation: feeling stressed about what might happen

stoicism.text: If you are distressed by anything external, the pain is not due to the thing itself, but to your estimate of it; and this you have the power to revoke at any moment.
stoicism.situation: being angry at external events or actions of others

stoicism.text: No person is handed a burden that they are not equipped by nature to bear. Every difficulty is an opportunity to practice virtue.

tao.text: Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished. If you search for peace, return to the source. Stillness is the lord of restlessness.
When you are content to be simply yourself and don't compare or compete, everybody will respect you. Softness overcomes hardness; yield to remain whole.
He who knows others is wise. He who knows himself is enlightened. He who is content is rich.
